Location: FKiSS Actions > setframe

Action: Setframe(group, frame)

Related Actions: letframe
See also: FKiSS, Events, Actions

setframe(group, frame)

First defined in: FKiSS4
The setframe action sets the current group frame number of group to frame. If the group does not have the specified frame, then all cels in the group are unmapped.
Cels in group which are in frame are mapped. Cels in group which are not in frame are unmapped.
group must a valid group.
frame may be a number or a variable representing the frame number.

Example:

;@ setframe(!MyGroup, 3) ; Sets the current frame in !MyGroup to 3.
